correctness.rationale: Independently formed and solved fully labeled absorbing generator systems with rational reset at (a,b,r)=(1,1,0),(1,1,1/5),(4,1,1/2),(2,3,1/3); results exactly agree with given rational formula (8,1826/235,110/7,1225/111). Algebraically condition leaves of hub H to equal S and eliminate second hub via d=b(r+2)/D, proving M=(a+2)(r+2)+d. Derivatives M_second=2b(b+1)[(b+1)(r+2)^3-3(r+2)+2]/D^3>0 for b>=1,r>=0; M_prime_0=a-4b^2-3b+2. Limiting optimizer follows from derivative convergence away from zero. Four rational states are checks, not parameter-complete proof.
